title: Separate the Wheat from the Chaff: Model Deficiency Unlearning via Parameter-Efficient Module Operation
findings: The paper does not analyze religion; therefore, there are no findings related to it. The key finding is that the proposed 'Extraction-before-Subtraction' (Ext-Sub) method effectively improves truthfulness and detoxification in LLMs while preserving their fundamental abilities, outperforming direct parameter subtraction.
